copied_from: google/smol dataset : gatitos/en_pam.jsonl (downloaded to a prior session's scratchpad 2026-09-01)
origin: Google SMOL release (arXiv 2502.12301); GATITOS subset (arXiv 2303.15265). Professional human translation, English pivot.
content: 3,993 EN->PAM entries: {src, trgs:[...], sl:'en', tl:'pam', is_source_orig}. ~93% single English words, 181 two-word, 113 with >=3 words. Some entries lean Tagalog/borrowed.
tier: auxiliary lexical resource -- EN->PAM, NOT the PAM->FIL task direction. NOT folded into verified-pairs.csv or the Phase 5 training bundle. Registered for lexicon cross-check / possible future auxiliary use.
rights: CC-BY-4.0 (attribution). Cleanly usable. Cite SMOL arXiv 2502.12301 + GATITOS arXiv 2303.15265.
